items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Yeah, I played with Allen too.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's in, let's see, how far, that's in the 600th block. Not this block, not that and the next one. Used to be a canal that year, but it's Philly now, it's a street now, you see? Well, it's on property, it's right there now. Did you ever play in his band?
Yeah, I played with Allen too. Well, you played with all the groups over there? Yeah, I played with him.
Snap drum, half time, bass drum. I played with Philly all the old times.
